name: Animal Companion Options
description: Choose an animal to serve as your companion. The PHB pool is gated by effective druid level: level-1 picks at 1+, alternative lists unlock at effective levels 4, 7, 10, 13, and 16. The engine treats `minEffectiveLevel` as an informational hint — selection is not blocked. Tier 16 picks gain a −5 effective-level penalty per PHB.
